    android:background="@color/white"

        android:layout_width="match_parent"

            android:contentDescription="Back" />

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:fontFamily="@font/plus_jakarta_sans_bold"
            android:gravity="center"
            android:text="@string/contact_us_title"

            android:textSize="18sp"

        <View
            android:layout_width="40dp"
            android:layout_height="40dp" />

    </LinearLayout>

    <ScrollView
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:fillViewport="true">

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="vertical"
            android:paddingHorizontal="24dp"
            android:paddingTop="8dp"

            <!-- Topic selection label -->

                android:textStyle="bold" />

            <!-- Topic grid \(2x2\) -->
            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
                android:orientation="vertical">

                <!-- Row 1 -->
                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:orientation="horizontal">

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/topicBilling"
                        android:layout_width="0dp"
                        android:layout_height="48dp"
                        android:layout_weight="1"
                        android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"
                        android:background="@drawable/bg_topic_item"
                        android:fontFamily="@font/plus_jakarta_sans_medium"
                        android:gravity="center"
                        android:text="@string/contact_topic_billing"
                        android:textColor="@color/deep_blue"
                        android:textSize="14sp" />

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/topicAnalysis"
                        android:layout_width="0dp"
                        android:layout_height="48dp"
                        android:layout_weight="1"
                        android:background="@drawable/bg_topic_item"
                        android:fontFamily="@font/plus_jakarta_sans_medium"
                        android:gravity="center"
                        android:text="@string/contact_topic_analysis"
                        android:textColor="@color/deep_blue"
                        android:textSize="14sp" />

                </LinearLayout>

                <!-- Row 2 -->
                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                    android:orientation="horizontal">

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/topicBug"
                        android:layout_width="0dp"
                        android:layout_height="48dp"
                        android:layout_weight="1"
                        android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"
                        android:background="@drawable/bg_topic_item"
                        android:fontFamily="@font/plus_jakarta_sans_medium"
                        android:gravity="center"
                        android:text="@string/contact_topic_bug"
                        android:textColor="@color/deep_blue"
                        android:textSize="14sp" />

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/topicGeneral"
                        android:layout_width="0dp"
                        android:layout_height="48dp"
                        android:layout_weight="1"
                        android:background="@drawable/bg_topic_item"
                        android:fontFamily="@font/plus_jakarta_sans_medium"
                        android:gravity="center"
                        android:text="@string/contact_topic_general"
                        android:textColor="@color/deep_blue"
                        android:textSize="14sp" />

                </LinearLayout>

            </LinearLayout>

            <!-- Message input -->
            <EditText
                android:id="@+id/etMessage"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="160dp"
                android:layout_marginTop="24dp"
                android:background="@drawable/bg_message_input"
                android:fontFamily="@font/plus_jakarta_sans"
                android:gravity="top|start"
                android:hint="@string/contact_message_hint"
                android:inputType="textMultiLine"
                android:padding="16dp"
                android:textColor="@color/deep_blue"
                android:textColorHint="@color/deep_blue_50"
                android:textSize="14sp" />

            <!-- Attach screenshot -->
            <LinearLayout
                android:id="@+id/btnAttach"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="48dp"
                android:layout_marginTop="16dp"
                android:background="@drawable/bg_attach_button"
                android:gravity="center"
                android:orientation="horizontal">

                <ImageView
                    android:layout_width="20dp"
                    android:layout_height="20dp"
                    android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"
                    android:importantForAccessibility="no"
                    android:src="@drawable/ic_attach"
                    app:tint="@color/deep_blue" />

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/tvAttachLabel"
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:fontFamily="@font/plus_jakarta_sans_medium"
                    android:text="@string/contact_attach"
                    android:textColor="@color/deep_blue"
                    android:textSize="14sp" />

            </LinearLayout>

            <!-- Attached image preview -->
            <ImageView
                android:id="@+id/imgAttached"
                android:layout_width="80dp"
                android:layout_height="80dp"
                android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
                android:importantForAccessibility="no"
                android:scaleType="centerCrop"
                android:visibility="gone" />

            <!-- Send button -->
            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/btnSend"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="52dp"
                android:layout_marginTop="24dp"
                android:background="@drawable/bg_contact_button"
                android:fontFamily="@font/plus_jakarta_sans_bold"
                android:gravity="center"
                android:text="@string/contact_send"
                android:textColor="@color/white"
                android:textSize="15sp"
                android:textStyle="bold" />

        </LinearLayout>

    </ScrollView>

</LinearLayout>
XMLEOF)
